correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the focal definitions and quantifiers. The lower bound is exact from the source. No experiment substitutes for the universal argument.

value.rationale: Suppression conditionality constants are a standard structural invariant in greedy approximation. Determining their logarithmic order for the new semi-greedy/non-quasi-greedy example explains the severity of its pathology: quasi-greediness fails even though arbitrary finite coordinate projections grow only on the classical logarithmic scale. This is a natural invariant of the source construction, not an arbitrary slice or a routine numerical increment.
